posts.title: Polynomials with Predicate: a Dialectica reading
posts.description: I have just put up a new preprint, Polynomials with Predicates: a Dialectica Reading . It started from a fairly simple observation: if you take a Dialectica object and forget its predicate, what remains looks very much like a polynomial.
